Initial release of gcp-fullstack – a full-stack project agent for Google Cloud Platform with GitHub and Cloudflare.

- Provides a planning protocol to ensure safe and well-documented project bootstrapping before any action.
- Uses decision trees to select the best GCP compute, database, and auth services for each project.
- Supports scaffolding with popular frameworks (Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Remix, Astro) and initializes relevant files.
- Generates starter `lib/`, `hooks/`, `types/` structure and framework-specific configs.
- Sets up sensible `.gitignore` and `.env.example` files tailored to selected services.
- Integrates best practices for GitHub and Cloudflare configuration via environment variables.
- Focuses on new project/init-only actions for safety—never overwrites existing env or credential files.
